title.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光

texts.zh:
虽然我们成功挑起了冲突，但行动并未完全按照计划进行。我们的一个特工的通讯被截获，导致我们暗中的行动被所有相关方知晓。

我们试图辩解，但毫无用处。此事件不仅损害了我们与参战方的关系，还在星系范围内玷污了我们的声誉。
texts.en:
Though we managed to incite a conflict, the operation did not go entirely to plan. One of our agents' communications was intercepted, revealing our covert actions to all parties involved.

Our attempts to explain away the affair were ineffective. Not only has this event harmed our relationships with the belligerents, but the scandal has damaged our reputation on a galactic scale.

summary.text:
# 代理人战争准备遭曝光 / Proxy Warmongering Revealed

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:13509-13709 (5050-5060)`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt (on_proxy_war_started → 5050; on_war_beginning → 5051)`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

代理人战争开始时（on_proxy_war_started → 5050），每有一个进攻方，煽动者就有10%几率被标记为“败露”。当这场代理人战争真正打响（on_war_beginning → 5051）且煽动者已败露时触发。

When a proxy war starts (on_proxy_war_started → 5050) the instigator has a 10% chance per attacker to be marked "busted". When the proxy war actually begins (on_war_beginning → 5051) with a busted instigator, this fires.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

7天后：被卷入的一方收到 5055（获得对煽动者的负面看法），煽动者收到 5060（若为星海共同体成员，得到十年的负面修正）。

7 days later the involved country gets 5055 (negative opinion of the instigator) and the instigator gets 5060 (a 10-year negative modifier if a Galactic Community member).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个窗口是同一事件对不同帝国的通知，并行而非互斥。

The two windows are notices of the same event to different empires — parallel, not exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

两者正文按是否星海共同体成员变化。

Both texts vary by Galactic Community membership.

Added a parallel group for the two perspectives.
